Meaning and Math.

• Purpose: a linear transformation of the input
• Formula:
• Single sample: y = W Tx + b
• Batch: ˆY = XW + 1bT
• Library:
• PyTorch: torch.nn.Linear
• Keras: keras.layers.Dense

title: Mathematical View
text:
Mathematical View
Mathematical Formula
Linear Regression
• For a single sample x ∈RD, the linear regression model computes:
ˆy = W Tx + b
where W ∈RD×K is the weight matrix and b ∈RK is the bias vector.
• Batch: X ∈RB×D (row n is xT
n ):
ˆY = XW + 1bT
where ˆY ∈RB×K is the model output and b ∈RK is the bias vector.
Linear Regression is a one-layer neural network without activation.

title: Training Methods
text:
Training Methods
Overview
Two Ways to Train Linear Regression
• Closed-form Solution (Analytical)
• Solve parameters directly using mathematics
• No iteration required
• Applicable only to simple linear models
• Gradient Descent (Iterative Optimization)
• Treat training as an optimization problem
• Update parameters iteratively
• General approach for deep learning
Linear Regression is one of the few models that can be trained in both ways.
